summaries.summary: The page presents a chart titled 'Testing Alignment of HR Deliverables' that evaluates how four strategic performance drivers align with four HR deliverables on a scale of -100 to +100. The HR deliverables are Employment Stability among Senior R&D Staff, Team-Based Behaviors, Strategy-Focused Performance, and High-Talent Staffing Level. The strategic drivers include Shorten product development times, Enhance customer focus and responsiveness, Enhance productivity, and Develop and successfully manage joint ventures.
key_facts: The chart evaluates HR deliverables against four strategic performance drivers.
HR deliverables listed: Employment Stability among Senior R&D Staff, Team-Based Behaviors, Strategy-Focused Performance, High-Talent Staffing Level.
Strategic performance drivers: Shorten product development times, Enhance customer focus and responsiveness, Enhance productivity, Develop and successfully manage joint ventures.
Scoring scale: -100 to +100, with -100 meaning counterproductive, 0 meaning little or no effect, +100 meaning significantly enables, and DNK meaning don't know or have no opinion.
visible_text: Please indicate the degree to which each HR deliverable in the chart below would currently enable each strategic driver, on a scale of -100 to +100.
–100: This deliverable is counterproductive for enabling this driver.
0: This deliverable has little or no effect on this driver.
+100: This deliverable significantly enables this driver.
DNK: Don't know or have no opinion.
